proof_scope: In progress. R1762 converts small augmented-family expansion into actual unweighted and Jacobian-weighted indicator error. SmallExpansionSymmDiff proves a finite-measure common-cover inequality, inclusion of each generator/inverse image in the actual augmented cover, and the symmetric-difference bound B=2*sigma*M+2*(M-M_prime)+32*eta*M_prime for the centrally trimmed set T. It substitutes the existing trimming loss to give an explicit bound in sigma, delta, eta and m/K. IndicatorPullbackError proves the pointwise indicator/symmetric-difference identity, integrability of the square, and the exact unit-interval integral as the measure of the inverse-map image symmetric difference. Both generator and inverse corollaries are proved. WeightedIndicatorError proves measurability and a pointwise square-root-Jacobian error estimate, derives integrability of the actual weighted error before comparing integrals, and bounds its unit-interval energy by 2*(1+32*eta)*B+2*(32*eta)^2*M_prime. The central-trim corollary replaces B by C*M, where C=2*sigma+4*m/K*(1+delta)+32*eta, and M_prime by M. This proves almost-invariance of the uncentered trimmed indicator locally on [0,1]; global centering and the normalized spectral input remain separate obligations.
